description: Keep Renovate's PR count low and readable, for every e-llabo repository (inherited org-wide through e-llabo/renovate-config): one weekly PR per repo for all non-major updates, majors only on request from the Dependency Dashboard, at most 3 open Renovate PRs per repo. Security fixes are not grouped and not scheduled (Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts defaults).

packageRules.description: Every minor, patch, digest and pin update in ONE weekly PR per repository.
Major versions open no PR until someone ticks them on the repository's Dependency Dashboard issue.
